verdict.rationale: Jitsu ships headless automation surfaces of its own: jitsu-cli, described as 'a real command-line interface that does everything the UI does', with init/deploy for Functions from your own repo. It also has a Management HTTP API and named API tokens with expiration, and the docs explicitly cover CI and headless environments authenticating with a personal API key instead of the browser flow. missing for 10: a documented CI pipeline recipe for jitsu-cli (e.g. GitHub Actions example or non-interactive flags), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, and confirmation of the OpenAPI reference (the probe found no openapi.json at the candidate paths).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: jitsu-cli — a real command-line interface that does everything the UI does.

build and deploy them from your own repo with the Jitsu CLI — `jitsu-cli init` scaffolds a TypeScript project with tests, and `jitsu-cli deploy` ships it to your workspace.
